caption: The drawing features two detailed pencil illustrations of a spoon, each shown from a different angle. The top view displays the spoon handle extending to the right, with the bowl of the spoon on the left, showing the smooth, slightly curved surface. The second illustration below shows the spoon with its bowl on the left and the handle stretching to the right, but this time the underside of the spoon is visible. Markings are visible on the handle, with some engraved text near the neck and some small letters near the handle’s end. The composition is monochromatic, rendered in shades of grey on a pale, off-white background. In the lower center of the image, there is a smaller, simplified diagram of the spoon with measurements and lines indicating dimensions. The drawing is bordered by a faint rectangular outline, and there is some handwritten text in the bottom right corner, including a scale notation "SCALE ½ = 1'" and a signature.
title: Silver Spoon
